archetypes.name: dyn-route-exit
archetypes.rationale: New route-exit router owns post-driver branch classification and retry state.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the new ship route-exit implementation and tests. Focus on required JSON validation, rc-file precedence, handoff env safety, transient retry persistence, and exit-code behavior. Check that prose and wrapper sidecars align with the Python contract. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.rationale: OOS checkpoint bookkeeping moved from prompt prose into Python.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the Step 8 OOS checkpoint router end to end. Focus on disposition stderr preservation, no child stdout leakage, run-id precedence, ndjson filed counts, manifest stamping failure behavior, and OOS_PENDING state patch preservation. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
